encryption_details.algorithm: RC4 (standard 256-byte KSA and PRGA); decrypts a 64-byte embedded payload in place
encryption_details.key_storage: 16-byte plaintext key hard-coded at the start of .rdata (VA 0x140005000), immediately followed by the separately addressed string "ntdll.dll"; the 64-byte ciphertext is stored at .data VA 0x140004000-0x14000403f and copied to the stack before decryption

anti_analysis: Sandboxie loaded-module detection using GetModuleHandleA("sbiedll.dll"); when present, the program sleeps for 30,000 ms and exits before decryption/injection
The program also probes loaded "dbghelp.dll" and resolves "SymSetOptions", but the result is discarded and does not change control flow; no debugger-specific PEB flag check is confirmed

injection_details.method: Manual PE mapping into a remote process followed by CreateRemoteThread at the mapped image entry point
injection_details.target_process: explorer.exe; falls back to its own process ID if explorer.exe is not found
injection_details.process_access: OpenProcess with access mask 0x43a (create-thread, VM operation/read/write, and query-information rights)
injection_details.payload: A 64-byte RC4-encrypted blob from .data is decrypted on the stack and passed to the PE manual-mapping routine
injection_details.payload_write: NtWriteVirtualMemory is resolved dynamically from ntdll.dll. The mapper writes PE headers using SizeOfHeaders, then writes each section from PointerToRawData to remote_base + VirtualAddress using the section VirtualSize.
injection_details.relocations: Computes remote_base minus preferred ImageBase, walks the base-relocation directory, handles IMAGE_REL_BASED_DIR64 entries, reads each remote 8-byte value with ReadProcessMemory, adds the delta, and writes it back with NtWriteVirtualMemory.
injection_details.execution: CreateRemoteThread starts at remote_base + AddressOfEntryPoint with remote_base as the thread parameter; it waits up to 10,000 ms and closes the thread/process handles.
